definitions.explanation: A covert agent or mercenary in feudal Japan, trained in espionage, sabotage, disguise, and martial arts. In modern usage, also refers to the popular cultural image of these figures.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{忍者|にんじゃ} were covert agents active during Japan's feudal period (roughly 15th–17th centuries). Their primary roles included espionage, reconnaissance, and sabotage rather than direct combat. The most famous ninja clans were based in {伊賀|いが} (Mie Prefecture) and {甲賀|こうか} (Shiga Prefecture).

{忍者|にんじゃ} appears frequently in pop culture. Japan has several ninja-themed tourist attractions, including {忍者|にんじゃ}⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧ (ninja houses) and {忍者|にんじゃ}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (ninja experience activities).
